title: Package record
description: packages/<owner>/<name>/package.json — the package-level record, and the only file in a package directory that may be edited after publication.

name.description: Must match the directory name exactly, casing included. Ids keep their author's casing (Descolada/OCR), but comparison is case-insensitive everywhere and the registry rejects two ids differing only by case.

license.description: An SPDX identifier, or NOASSERTION when the source states no licence. Never guess one.

versioning.description: upstream: the author publishes versions. registry: 0.x versions are synthesized because the source has none.

yanked.description: Releases withdrawn from new resolution. An existing lockfile still installs them; yanking is not deletion.
